body.objective: Issue the final pre-asymptotic go/no-go verdict for the complex-compensator conformal parent after local, Lorentzian, global-topological, relational, nonlinear and scale-generation gates have all terminated.
body.stop_condition: Import by exact hashes the terminal complex-compensator quantum synthesis, global-anomaly audit and Einstein-scale-generation disposition. Verify that they use one action, field inventory, gauge group, real structure, background specialization, renormalization scheme and coupling normalization, or certify the first mismatch. Assemble a typed theorem ledger separating: classical BV completeness; causal Green/Hadamard status; local perturbative QME status; global anomaly status; reduced pairing and clock health; nonlinear Einstein/additional closure; and introduced versus generated scales. State the maximal coherent changed theory that survives all gates and the exact assumptions under which it does so. If any gate fails, state whether the failure is a no-go for this action, this phase, this topology or only the tested construction class. If the ledger is coherent, define the precise asymptotic phase-space, scattering and phenomenology work that is newly justified, without claiming those results in advance.
body.current_gate: pre-asymptotic quantum-consistency verdict for one coherent complex-compensator theory
body.forbid: no averaging contradictory gates into a positive verdict; no local anomaly theorem substituted for a global one; no gauge-fixed scale called dynamically generated; no reduced mode carrier called a Hilbert space; no compact-background result called an asymptotic particle theorem; no strict pure-Weyl rescue claim; no Standard Model, unification, dark-sector, scattering, unitarity or complete quantum-gravity claim
activates: a justified asymptotic compensator-theory phase-space programme
or a scoped terminal no-go for the tested compensator construction
body.resource_hint: FINAL PRE-ASYMPTOTIC COMPENSATOR GATE. This is a synthesis item, not permission to reconstruct missing producer calculations. Any action, topology or normalization mismatch is terminal evidence for this item.
notes: The result may justify beginning scattering and phenomenology, but cannot itself establish either.
A negative verdict can still identify a narrower viable topology, sector or changed action.
The strict and compensator-extended theories remain distinct at every lifecycle stage.
